---
title: "Lightbox: figure alignment"
# bd-kcpkgftw. Port of Q1 smoke-all/2023/12/08/7619.qmd and 2023/11/15/
# 7516-b.qmd: `fig-align` keeps working on lightboxed figures (the image
# is looked up through the wrapping link), for plain and cross-referenced
# figures alike.
lightbox: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'a.lightbox[href="images/mv-0.png"] > img'
          - 'a.lightbox[href="images/mv-1.png"] > img'
          - 'a.lightbox[href="images/mv-2.png"] > img'
        - - 'img[fig-align]'
          - 'img[data-fig-align]'
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - - 'class="quarto-figure quarto-figure-right">\s*.figure>\s*.a href="images/mv-0\.png" class="lightbox"'
          - 'id="fig-placeholder" class="[^"]*quarto-figure-right[^"]*"[\s\S]{0,200}?a href="images/mv-1\.png" class="lightbox"'
          - 'class="quarto-figure quarto-figure-left">\s*.figure>\s*.a href="images/mv-2\.png" class="lightbox"'
        - - 'quarto-figure-center'
---

![A placeholder image](images/mv-0.png){fig-alt="A placeholder image." fig-align="right" width=20%}

![A placeholder image](images/mv-1.png){#fig-placeholder fig-alt="A placeholder image." fig-align="right" width=20%}

![Left](images/mv-2.png){fig-align="left"}
